prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Play a quick mini-game while your pet prepares its room!", "Toy Workshop", "Tap items on the desk to build your pet's first favorite toy while setup finishes."]
1: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion!", "Swipe through quick tips to learn how to interact with your pet on screen.", "Drag to move • Double click to talk • Right-click to send to tray"]
2: ["Choose Personality & Voice", "Select how your pet talks and behaves on your desktop.", "Playful, Curious, Calm"]
3: ["Pick Your Companion Archetype", "Explore different pet personalities designed for work and play.", "Select Archetype"]
4: ["Your Pet is Hatching...", "Setting up desktop graphics engine and companion AI response files."]
5: ["Sign In to Save & Restore Your Pets", "Log into your account so your desktop companion and saved accessories are safely backed up.", "Signing in ensures your pet stays safe across device restarts or app updates."]
6: ["Quick tip: Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to hide or bring your pet to the front!"]
7: ["Adopt Your Companion & Claim Free Accessory", "Every adoption today comes with an exclusive founder's desktop toy badge!", "Includes Free Founder Toy"]
8: []
9: ["Don't worry! You can change your companion path or add more pets anytime in app settings."]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras and creates urgency with time-limited offer language.
